_comment: Curated list of project ideas that have actually been built. This is maintained by hand (the daily routine never edits it). Two entry shapes are supported: (1) a 'ref' to an existing idea by {date, n} to promote it into the Implemented section, optionally overriding fields and adding url/repo; (2) a fully standalone project. See ideas/SCHEMA.md.

projects.notes: Built in one session with zero runtime deps beyond React: verified Machado 2009 CVD matrices in linear sRGB, OKLab confusion detection, hue-preserving contrast fixes, PNG/print reports, 11 unit tests. Also deployed to GitHub Pages at pisanuw.github.io/c1.

Built in one session: five algorithms (BFS, DFS, Dijkstra, Greedy, A*) emitting a single event trace consumed by both the canvas renderer and the narrator. Narration is rule-based instead of the suggested Claude API calls, so it is free, offline, and always matches the algorithm state. Side-by-side compare mode, RLE share links in the URL hash, seeded maze generator, 20 vitest cases.

In progress since 2026-08-20. CODE COMPLETE and pushed to Claude-capstone/schema-storyteller (main): client-side SQL/Prisma/JSON-Schema parser, entity-relationship narrator, rule-based reviewer, Markdown export; 71 vitest tests, 88.88% coverage; lint/typecheck/build all green. DEPLOY BLOCKED, 3rd run (2026-08-20), and the blocker is credentials the repo owner controls, not the code. Both deploy paths are down. (1) GitHub Actions: the repo secret NETLIFY_AUTH_TOKEN is invalid, so deploy run #19 fails for EVERY site with 'netlify api listSites Unauthorized' then 'No teams available'; this also blocks accessibility-lens, emoji-lingua, and mult-streak-edge, not just this project. (2) Local CLI: this session's egress policy denies all Netlify hosts (CONNECT to netlify-mcp.netlify.app and api.netlify.com both return 403), so the connector's deploy command cannot run from here. New this run: the Netlify MCP connector itself authenticates fine (it relays server-side), which confirms the Netlify ACCOUNT is healthy and only the stored CI token is stale. Progress made: schema-storyteller/deploy/target.yml now pins siteId 0fe0b047-2ef4-40ec-aded-1a35dc15e076 and accountSlug yusuf-pisan, so once a valid token exists the deploy targets the existing empty site directly instead of failing in the create-site fallback. ACTION NEEDED FROM OWNER: rotate NETLIFY_AUTH_TOKEN in the Claude-capstone repo secrets, then re-run the Deploy workflow; a future run finishes steps 5-7. Deliberately NOT applying the 'failed twice, abandon it' rule: that rule exists to drop ideas that turn out unbuildable, whereas this one is finished, tested, and pushed, and any replacement idea would hit the identical deploy wall. Abandoning would discard working code and leave the project permanently untracked. Separately, the Render service mult-streak is suspended ('cannot deploy suspended service').
